storyline.real: Capelli, seventh on the grid, runs non-stop in the Leyton House while the front-runners stop for tyres; he leads from lap 33 until Prost passes him on lap 78, and finishes second, 8.6 seconds behind
storyline.headline: Capelli's Leyton House goes the distance and wins at Paul Ricard

hidden.label: Win with no more than one tyre stop

eras.briefing: Paul Ricard, July 1990. Capelli started seventh in the Leyton House. The front-runners stop for fresh tyres from lap 20; Capelli and Gugelmin ran the race on one set. Prost, from fourth on the grid, stopped on lap 27. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.
